title: Card Display Demo
description: 2 captured saves. One original BASIC player; historical bugs remain.
versionOrder: Within each capture, save order is retained. Cross-capture ordering is a presentation guess; tape numbers do not establish development dates. Similarity clusters are provisional, and collected saves are not necessarily revisions of one program.

versions.label: CARD DISPLAY DEMO
versions.note: validated payload; runtime untested. Ordered lines, consistent pointers, normal end; exact match across original and both-channel variants; runtime untested
versions.unavailableReason: Another recovered save; the site offers one selected player.
versions.startupSource:
1 CLS
10 C$(1)=CHR$(140)+CHR$(191)+CHR$(157)+CHR$(132):C$(5)=" "+CHR$(138)
20 C$(2)=CHR$(160)+CHR$(190)+CHR$(180):C$(6)=" "+CHR$(139)+CHR$(129)
30 C$(3)=CHR$(191)+CHR$(190)+CHR$(149):C$(7)=CHR$(130)+CHR$(135)
40 C$(4)=C$(2):C$(8)=C$(5)
200 V=RND(13):S=RND(4):GOSUB1000
205 INPUT"LOC";L
210 GOTO200
300 GOTO300
1000 IFV=1THENP$="ACE"ELSEIFV<11THENP$=STR$(V)ELSEIFV=11THENP$="JACK"ELSEIFV=12THENP$="QUEEN"ELSEIFV=13THENP$="KING"
1010 PRINT@L,P$;" "C$(S);:PRINT@L+64,P$;" "C$(S+4);
2000 RETURN
